name: Campsite story-page reconstruction
prompt: Recreate the attached campsite reference as an original 256×144 Open Dots page. Start with get_pixel_art_guide and get_storybook, create a limited named palette, then build six reusable visual groups: striped tent, campfire, Mira, fox, pine tree, and star cluster. Use a flat painted sky and grassy clearing, stamp the pine tree four times and the star cluster several times, place the tent on the left, Mira walking near the center, the fire at center, and the fox looking back on the right. Build assets in outline, fill, shade, and highlight passes; inspect their PNGs; stamp them back-to-front; add the exact text ‘Mira followed the little fox.’ as rasterized page text; inspect the final page and iterate. Preserve the simple three-layer composition, readable silhouettes, cool moonlight, and warm firelight without copying pixels literally.

rubric.name: composition
rubric.criteria: At 256×144, the scene has three readable depth bands with tent left, fire near center, Mira moving through the middle, and fox looking back on the right.

rubric.name: characters
rubric.criteria: Mira and the fox have distinct readable silhouettes, clear facing directions, simple poses, and contact shadows.

rubric.name: asset_reuse_and_layout
rubric.criteria: Tent, fire, characters, tree, and stars read as coherent reusable assets; trees and stars are repeated intentionally without clutter.

rubric.name: pixel_craft
rubric.criteria: Crisp clustered pixels, 1–2 pixel outlines, simple outline/base/shadow/highlight ramps, and no soft downsampled or noisy texture.

rubric.name: story_text
rubric.criteria: The exact sentence ‘Mira followed the little fox.’ is legible in the upper-left sky, rasterized into the page, and has no caption box.

rubric.name: palette_and_lighting
rubric.criteria: Limited cohesive night palette with cool navy moonlight and a clear warm orange campfire focal glow.
